scope: Separate standard-library metadata observer only. No existing source profile, diagnostic, learner, active worker, source admission or failed record is changed.
cpu_observation: Record actual one-or-two simultaneous threads and affinity; never assert one actual affinity entry from one requested CPU.
candidate_paths: /etc/slurm/{slurm,gres,cgroup}.conf plus only the unique absolute actual SlurmdSpoolDir/conf-cache/{slurm,gres,cgroup}.conf
returned_identifier_sequence: Prepare null-ID immutable plan and stage exact published source; root submits --hold --no-requeue, fsyncs actual returned ID in canonical ledger, invokes bind-held-identifier with that returned ID and freshly observed owned reservation, verifies root submission/held state, then root releases. Numeric run rechecks both frozen and live exact canonical ledger membership and returned-ID binding before any owned ID query.
raw_scope: Filtered slurm.conf and running configuration only; ordinary gres/cgroup exact bytes/base64/hash; owner/mode/path-chain metadata and explicit absence/read errors. No NVML, CUDA, JAX, slurmd execution or device opens.
